scope: Descriptive post-registration source diagnostic using candidate opening references only. No returns, exits, news labels or future price values are used to select cases; no changes to frozen candidate universe. Largest cases are selected solely by opening-reference discrepancy.

method.comparison: Exact Decimal(str(value)); no tolerance used to count mismatches. Only rows with30 complete opening-minute bars enter the comparison.
method.quantiles: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*p among252 absolute differences, including no equal-price rows.
method.near_threshold_case_definition: Among mismatches, regular-minute gap is within50basis points of the10percent threshold. All status-changing cases are also listed regardless of distance.

coverage.omitted_count_reason: Not measurable from this conditional1079candidate sample; the fulluniverse was not screened with regular0930minute opens.

input_feed_check.interpretation: Both cached daily batches and these minute requests explicitly use SIP/raw. This observed mismatch is not established as a comparison of IEX versus SIP. It remains possible that distinct aggregation rules, timing, corrections, identity mapping or other unexamined factors matter per case.

official_source.title: Alpaca Market Data FAQ - How are bars aggregated?
exact_excerpts: Minute and daily bars are aggregated from trades.
Some rules are different for minute and daily bars.
O Market Center Opening Trade ABC MD 🟢 🟢 🟢
Q Market Center Official Open ABC MD 🔴 🔴 🔴
T Extended Hours Trade ABCO M 🟢 🟢 🟢 T Extended Hours Trade ABCO D 🔴 🔴 🟢
A trade can have more than one condition. In this case the strictest rule is applied.
Open is set if it hasn't been set yet and the update open / close rule is 🟢 or 🟡

documented: Minute and daily bars aggregate directly from trades using SIP timestamps, minute buckets and NewYork day buckets; daily bars are not documented as merely aggregating regular-session minute bars.

Eligibility depends on tape, condition and bar type. O opening trades may update both; Q official-open messages update neither in Alpaca table. These are distinct conditions, so do not identify a bar open automatically with an official exchange auction price.

G (Nasdaq bunched sold), P (prior reference), Z (sold out of sequence) and4 (derivatively priced) can initialize daily open/close but not minute open/close under the listed rules. Multiple conditions use the strictest rule.

T extended-hours trades update minute prices and volume; on daily bars they update volume but not prices. Thus daily volume can include qualifying extended-hours trades, and the prior20daily-volume denominator is not established as RTH-only.
Bar open is first price allowed to initialize that bar under its combined conditions. Missing bars can mean no price-eligible trades, not necessarily a download fault.
not_established: Which particular trade or condition caused any of the252 mismatches; no per-case raw-trade reconstruction was done.
Whether an individual difference is an error, correction, timing issue, identity/split issue, or expected aggregation behavior.
Whether any bar open is the listingexchange official auction price or an immediately executable price.
How many true regular-minute10percent gaps failed the initial daily-open screen; neither0nor any estimated count is supported.
study_implications: Retain the originally selected1079daily-open candidates as a conditional sample; do not label it a complete universe of regular-session10percent gappers.
Actual minute-gap confirmation rejects5known daily-screen false inclusions, but cannot repair unobserved false exclusions.
Do not redefine frozen thresholds or discard mismatches solely because of eventual returns; preserve all252 diagnostic cases.
A future revision requires an independently declared screen over all prior-liquidity-eligible symbols using regular-minute openings, historical identity control and clear volume session definitions.
Investigating causes requires underlying trades with conditions, timestamps, corrections/cancels and exchange/session mapping. Bar-to-bar differences alone are insufficient.
